plan.title: Enable vendor masking on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the RFQ has a bid sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite at least two participating vendors.
Publish the RFQ so it is live.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Have the first participating vendor submit a bid.
Confirm the first bid was accepted.
Open the live RFQ Participants list for the remaining vendor.
Submit a buyer-side bid for the second participating vendor.
Confirm the second bid was accepted.
Go to the RFQ response screen where the Actions control is available.
Open the response Actions menu.
Verify that enabling Vendor Masking is offered.
Enable vendor masking for the live RFQ.
Open the comparison view to inspect the masked vendor labels.
Confirm the first vendor is represented by the numbered alias Vendor 1.
Confirm the second vendor is represented by the numbered alias Vendor 2.
